title: Selling Plans Final Value Fee Rate Table
content:
This table sets out, for every **Selling Plans** tier, the figures the final value fees on a sold order are billed at: the variable fee rate of each fee group, the item categories that map to each group, the amount the variable fee is computed on, the per-order threshold and the rate above it, and the fixed per-order fee.

## Variable final value fee rate by fee group

| Plan | Most categories | Electronics and computers | Apparel and shoes | Large items |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | 13.25% | 9.35% | 15% | 8% |
| Starter Store | 13.25% | 9.35% | 15% | 8% |
| Basic Store | 12.7% | 9% | 14.5% | 7.75% |
| Premium Store | 12.35% | 8.75% | 14% | 7.5% |
| Anchor Store | 12.35% | 8.5% | 13.5% | 7.25% |
| Enterprise Store | 11.5% | 8% | 13% | 7% |

## Item category to fee group (identical on every tier)

| Order item category | Fee group |
|---|---|
| Electronics; computers | Electronics and computers |
| Apparel; shoes | Apparel and shoes |
| Large appliances; furniture | Large items |
| Home and kitchen; toys; beauty; grocery | Most categories |

## Figures common to every tier

| Item | Figure on every Selling Plans tier |
|---|---|
| Amount the variable fee is computed on (the fee basis) | The order's item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax |
| Portion of the fee basis charged at the fee group rate | Up to USD 7500.00 per order |
| Rate on the portion of the fee basis above USD 7500.00 | 2.35% |
| Per-order fee when the fee basis is at or below the breakpoint | USD 0.30 |
| Per-order fee when the fee basis is above the breakpoint | USD 0.40 |
| Breakpoint between the two per-order fees | Fee basis of USD 10.00 |

## Breakpoint, shown on both sides

- A hypothetical order with a fee basis of exactly USD 10.00 is at the breakpoint: its per-order fee is USD 0.30.
- A hypothetical order with a fee basis of USD 10.01 is above the breakpoint: its per-order fee is USD 0.40.
